story: Nifty 50 opened at 23,239, a gap-up of 0.81% from the previous close of 23,053.
The index dipped to a low of 23,207 (+0.67%) around 1:40 PM and touched a high of 23,441 (+1.68%) around 3:30 PM.
It settled at 23,441 (+1.68%), near the top of the day's range, so buyers held control into the close.
36 of the 50 Nifty stocks advanced and 13 declined; Bank Nifty lagged (+0.58%).
Latest institutional data (30 Oct): FII/FPI net +3599 Cr, DII net -818 Cr.
risks: Wall Street trades through tonight (from about 7:00 PM IST); the S&P 500 last closed at 7,580.07 (-1.82%), so US data and Fed commentary can swing the opening.
Brent crude is at US$108.90 (-7.43%); a sharp fall would help oil marketers and the rupee.
Currency and yields to track: USD/INR 94.900 (-0.27%), US 10-year yield 4.93% (-1.20%). A firmer dollar or higher US yields usually weigh on foreign flows.
GIFT Nifty keeps trading into the late evening, now 23,414.0 (-0.11% vs Nifty's close): the best live read on the next opening.
Nifty 50 results due on Tuesday: BAJAJFINSV, SBIN.
